typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tocalypsotradeservtkeywordfeedredid_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		PRODUCT_ID as decimal(38,0),
		INDEX_DEF_ID as decimal(38,0),
		INDEX_NAME as string,
		INDEX_ISSUER_ID as decimal(38,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcdsindexdef
fromcdsindexdef derive({Copy of INDEX_NAME} = INDEX_NAME,
		{Copy of PRODUCT_ID} = toString(PRODUCT_ID),
		{Copy of INDEX_ISSUER_ID} = toString(INDEX_ISSUER_ID),
		{Copy of INDEX_DEF_ID} = toString(INDEX_DEF_ID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		INDEX_NAME as string,
		INDEX_DEF_ID as string,
		PRODUCT_ID as string,
		INDEX_ISSUER_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		INDEX_NAME = {Copy of INDEX_NAME},
		INDEX_DEF_ID = {Copy of INDEX_DEF_ID},
		PRODUCT_ID = {Copy of PRODUCT_ID},
		INDEX_ISSUER_ID = {Copy of INDEX_ISSUER_ID}),
	partitionFileNames:[($tocalypsotradeservtkeywordfeedredid_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tocalypsotradeservtkeywordfeedredid
